title: Mythic Chroma
description: Adds textures for Mythic Metals' armors to Armor Chroma
body:
![The armor textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/017ff8ca6dff543fda6a0bc99d1062e6a9587037.png)

This resource pack adds textures for compatibility between [Mythic Metals](https://modrinth.com/mod/mythicmetals) and [Armor Chroma](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-chroma-for-fabric).

## Installation
To install this resource pack, do so as any other resource pack:
- Download the file appropriate to the Minecraft version you are on (e.g. 1.21.2)
- Put the downloaded file in `<install location>/resourcepacks`
- Start the game
- In Options -> Resource Packs, enable the resource pack

Note: This resource pack will not have any effect unless both mods are installed as well.
